replay.replay_authority: Only the House, under governed authority, may authorize a replay; no consumer or provider may initiate one.
replay.replay_evidence: Every replay records the authorizing authority, its reason, and the events re-emitted as governed evidence.
replay.replay_posture: Replayed events carry the same identity and a replay marker so consumers distinguish them from original emissions.

dedup.deduplication_scope: Per event identity within a tenant scope
